about_short_description.short_description: Rider is an e-com logistics startup in Pakistan, giving online shippers a tech-driven, customer-centric, solution to last mile delivery

product.name: Last-Mile Delivery Service
product.description: A service providing product pickup, transportation, and delivery to end-customers across Pakistan, with options for same-day and next-day delivery.

product.name: Merchant Portal
product.description: A web-based platform that connects merchants to Rider’s logistics network, enabling order management, pickup scheduling, and real-time tracking.

product.name: Customer App
product.description: A mobile application for end-customers to track deliveries in real-time and modify delivery details such as location, date, and time.

product.name: Cash Collection and Reconciliation Service
product.description: A service that manages safe cash collection from deliveries, en-route deposits, and provides instant or 24-hour cash reconciliation for merchants.

product.name: Cash Now, Deliver Later
product.description: A payment model allowing merchants to receive payment upon product pickup, providing early access to funds before delivery completion.

product.name: Nationwide Warehouse Movement and Fulfillment
product.description: A logistics service offering warehouse-to-warehouse product movement and fulfillment across Pakistan to support inventory management and distribution.
